strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Momentum — Paper
strategy.desc: Concentrated swing trades in liquid US large/mid-cap stocks and broad ETFs. NO leveraged ETFs, NO crypto. Entry on breakouts, momentum, and quality oversold snaps. Trailing stops on every position. NEUTRAL regime active: sizes trimmed ~25% from max.
rules: Enter on 2+ of: breakout above multi-week high, momentum leader in hot sector, oversold snapback off support, near-term catalyst.
Size: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
Initial 18% trailing stop on every entry — no naked positions.
Cut if −12% from entry unless dated catalyst imminent and thesis intact.
No new entries if daily loss ≥ −8%; stand down for month if MTD ≤ −25%.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16–24): trim new sizes ~25%; be choosier. RISK-OFF (>24): high-conviction only.
Universe: liquid US large/mid-cap stocks + broad/sector ETFs. NO leveraged ETFs, NO crypto, NO penny stocks (<$10).
